decisions.reason: The clarified bushing fit and piston-rod guidance do not change the existing fabrication sequence, raw material, nominal 82 mm post-weld bore, or premachining purpose.
The source does not change the M72x1.5 locking thread, its width, or the required 65 mm main-bushing space.
The bushing guidance and clearance-fit clarification does not affect the requirement to omit the keyway at cross section C-C.
The source corrects mechanical arrangement details but does not change assembly-aligned drawing numbering.
The source changes no material specification; CuSn12 for the bushing and S355 JRG2 for other parts remain unchanged.

Although the source says the drawings are incorrect, the concrete correction belongs to the atomic bushing guidance and retention Requirement; duplicating it under a broad drawing-content Requirement is unwarranted.
The mechanical clarification does not change the required IPT preference or STEP minimum file format.
The source does not alter the requirement to comply with the usual ČSN/EN drawing standards.
